name: Fauna
description: Fauna is a website template for veterinary clinics, with a pet switch for services and prices, a 24/7 emergency line, a vet team and a styled map. Warm apricot, deep navy and a dog and cat mascot give the website a friendly, trustworthy character. Replace the copy, illustrations, clinic details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with a mascot and buttons for a visit and the emergency line
Pet switch for services, vaccination prices and tips for dogs, cats, rabbits and exotic pets
24/7 emergency line with three steps for a pet that feels unwell
Price table for the most common treatments
First visit in four illustrated steps
Owner reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Visit form, opening hours and a styled map
Services list with three service subpages
Navigation, clinic details and legal links
